title.zh: 【美 SEC 执法主任：正密切关注预测市场内幕交易和操纵行为】
title.en: 【美 SEC 执法主任：正密切关注预测市场内幕交易和操纵行为】

current_state.zh: SEC Enforcement Director David Woodcock said the agency is closely monitoring prediction markets for insider trading and manipulation and expects to bring enforcement actions, noting that markets tied to public companies' key performance metrics or earnings data may fall under SEC jurisdiction.
current_state.en: SEC Enforcement Director David Woodcock said the agency is closely monitoring prediction markets for insider trading and manipulation and expects to bring enforcement actions, noting that markets tied to public companies' key performance metrics or earnings data may fall under SEC jurisdiction.
